positions.as_written: Measure on the coronal image through the mid body of the meniscus, where the tibial margin is a clear landmark.
Measure from the edge of the tibial plateau to the outer edge of the meniscus, excluding osteophyte from the tibial landmark.
Record which compartment, because medial extrusion is much more common and carries the clearer association with cartilage loss.
- Osteophyte must be excluded from the tibial landmark.
